$comment: Pins the SDK that builds the desktop's second YouTube engine.
Without this the runner uses whatever it happens to have preinstalled —
10.0.302 at the time of writing — and its publish arguments are handled
differently enough that MSBuild read the output path as a second project
and refused to build at all. The engine targets net8.0, so the 8.0 SDK is
what it should be built with, on a runner and on a clone alike.
rollForward stays on latestFeature so a machine with a newer 8.0.x patch
still builds, rather than demanding this exact number.
